description: Flour type reference. Hydration ranges assume a Swedish home baker with a pro mixer. Typical protein ranges refer to the label 'protein' value (dry basis).

flours.notes: Go-to flour for open crumb. Holds 82–85 % without drama on a pro mixer.
Struggles above 78 %. Use blends (80/20 with strong) for higher hydration.
Classic baguette flour profile. Slightly higher ash adds flavor and enzymatic activity.
Absorbs more water. Weakens gluten at >30 % share. Usually used as 10–20 % of blend.
Low gluten; use up to 20 % in wheat blend for flavor without sacrificing crumb. Pure rye needs a different approach.
Mucilage-dominant structure, not gluten. For wheat-dominant bakes, cap at 15 % share.
Gluten is fragile — over-mixes easily. Short speed-2 mix, more folds.
Yellow color, nutty flavor. Gluten short and strong. Blend 20–50 % with bread flour.

blending_notes.open_crumb_boule: 80 % strong bread + 10 % whole wheat + 10 % sifted. Hydration 82 %.
blending_notes.baguette_classic: 100 % T65 or strong bread flour. Hydration 78–82 %.
blending_notes.flavor_push: Add 10–15 % whole wheat or 15 % light rye to any wheat base to deepen flavor without closing crumb.
